from wtforms import validators
from wtforms.fields import RadioField
from wtforms.form import Form
class F(Form):
    c = RadioField(choices=[('a', 'Item 1'), ('b', 'Item 2')], validators=[validators.InputRequired()])
form = F()
opts = list(form.c)
seq = [[type(v).__name__ for v in o.validators] for o in opts]
print('validator_sequence', seq)
assert seq == [['InputRequired'], ['InputRequired']], seq
html = form.c()
print('render_marks', html.count('required'))
assert html.count('required') == 2, html
